# long-lived slot of a still-active 3.25 probation tuple, however, it is the
# real role/strategy-change exclusion source for canonical #269 quality=4.

# Native receive callback for the long-lived career carrier.  It records only
# callback observation; the already-authorized dispatch schedules the later
# postcondition audit, so a missing callback becomes an explicit audit RED
# instead of leaving the request pending forever.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_on_native_slot_received_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner = scope:liege
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_authorized
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_authorized = 1
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                who = scope:liege
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_subject value = this }
    }
}

# All native end modes are observed.  Only a newly requested revoke
# (END_REASON=1) can later seal a PIP-exit receipt.  Invalidation/vacating and
# package cleanup remain visible RED facts and can never masquerade as #277.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_on_native_slot_ended_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { $END_REASON$ = 2 }
        zg361_workforce_exit_fact_capture_role_failure_effect = yes
    }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_last_end_reason value = $END_REASON$ }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_last_end_owner value = scope:liege }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_last_end_subject value = this }
    if = {
        limit = { $END_REASON$ = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_revoked_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_revoked_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_revoked_subject value = this }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { $END_REASON$ = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_invalidated_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_invalidated_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_invalidated_subject value = this }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { $END_REASON$ = 3 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_vacated_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_vacated_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_vacated_subject value = this }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner = scope:liege
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_request_authorized
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_request_authorized = 1
            $END_REASON$ = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_exit_revoked_callback_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_exit_revoked_callback_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_exit_revoked_callback_subject value = this }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_pending = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_pending_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_pending_owner = scope:liege
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_request_authorized
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_request_dispatched
            var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_request_authorized = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_request_dispatched = 1
            $END_REASON$ = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_native_revoke_callback_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_native_revoke_callback_owner value = scope:liege }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_normal_exit_fact_native_revoke_callback_subject value = this }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_callback_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_callback_reason value = $END_REASON$ }
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_unexpected_native_end_seen value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_unexpected_native_end_reason value = $END_REASON$ }
    }
}

# Arm a persistent native career slot only after the exact #274 native
# appointment receipt has been consumed and its bounded carrier has really
# been package-revoked.  This public entry accepts no truth material.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_from_m274_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_state = 4
            $TICKET_SUBJECT$ = {
                has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                is_court_position_employer = {
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                    who = $TICKET_OWNER$
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 2 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
                EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
                EXPECTED_STATE = 4
            }
            $TICKET_OWNER$ = { zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes }
            $TICKET_SUBJECT$ = this
            is_alive = yes
            is_landed = yes
            liege = $TICKET_OWNER$
            has_variable = zg361_we_m274_business_object_created
            var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_state = 4
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_hired = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_hire_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_appointed_character = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = 3612741
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id > 0
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash > 0
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active = 1
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied >= 1
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed_operation = 274
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_cycle = $TICKET_CYCLE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_case = $TICKET_CASE$
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_state = 4
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_result = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_type_id = 3612741
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_id = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_hash = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_native_callback_seen = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_release_joined_by_consumer = 1
            NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending }
                var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending = 0
            }
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active }
                var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active = 0
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_state value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_position_type_id value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_id value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash }
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_seen
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_owner
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_subject
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_callback_seen
        remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_callback_reason
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_authorized value = 1 }
        $TICKET_OWNER$ = { set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_window_open value = 1 } }
        trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceexitfact.9000 days = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code value = 27701 }
    }
}

# D+1 native appointment dispatch.  The intent, authorization, and owner-side
# picker flag were committed by the public entry on the prior event boundary,
# so both can_appoint and the native receive callback read stable state.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_dispatch_native_arm_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_state = 4
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_authorized
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_authorized = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner = {
                zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_window_open
                var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_window_open = 1
                can_appoint_char_to_court_position = {
                    CHAR = root
                    COURT_POS = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                }
            }
            is_alive = yes
            is_landed = yes
            liege = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
            var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_owner = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_subject = this
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_cycle = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_cycle
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_case
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_hired = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_position_type_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_hash
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active = 1
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_case
            var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied >= 1
            NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
            NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_request_dispatched value = 1 }
        var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner = {
            appoint_court_position = {
                recipient = root
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
            }
            remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_window_open
        }
        trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceexitfact.9001 days = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner }
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner = { remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_window_open }
        }
        zg361_workforce_exit_fact_clear_arm_pending_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code value = 27702 }
    }
}

# D+1 arm audit.  No same-effect read-after-write is used to turn the native

    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending

            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_native_receive_callback_subject = this

            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                who = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
            }
            var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_owner = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
            var:zg361_we_m274_object_subject = this

            var:zg361_we_m274_object_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_hired = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_position_type_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_hash
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active = 1
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_case
            var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied >= 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_consumed = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_still_active = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_released_by_package = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_receipt_position_release_joined_by_consumer = 1
            NOT = { has_court_position = zg361_workforce_appointment_fact_court_position }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_owner value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_subject value = this }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_cycle value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_cycle }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_case value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_case }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_state value = 4 }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_appointment_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_hash }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_carrier_type_id value = 3612771 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_id value = { value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_id multiply = 1000 add = 277 } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_hash value = { value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_m274_receipt_hash multiply = 1000 add = 3612771 } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_native_receive_seen value = 1 }
        zg361_workforce_exit_fact_clear_arm_pending_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
                is_court_position_employer = {
                    court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                    who = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested value = 1 }
            trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceexitfact.9006 days = 1 }
        }
        else = { zg361_workforce_exit_fact_clear_arm_pending_effect = yes }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code value = 27703 }
    }
}

# Cleanup also crosses an event boundary.  Its callback therefore observes a
# committed cleanup intent and cannot be confused with an unrequested end.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_dispatch_cleanup_revoke_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested = 1
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_pending = 1
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                who = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner
            }
        }
        var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_arm_owner = {
            revoke_court_position = {
                recipient = root
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
            }
        }
    }
    zg361_workforce_exit_fact_clear_arm_pending_effect = yes
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_cleanup_revoke_requested
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 4 }
    set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code value = 27703 }
}

            has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle
            has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case
            has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state

            has_variable = zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash
            has_variable = zg361_b2_pip_outcome_code
            has_variable = zg361_b2_pip_outcome_result_grade
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_pending = 1
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_owner = $TICKET_OWNER$
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_subject = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle > 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case > 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state = 4
            var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_code = 2
            var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_result_grade = 1
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id > 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash > 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id > 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash > 0
            NOT = { var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id }
            NOT = { var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash }
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending }
                var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending = 0
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_former_slot_id value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_former_slot_hash value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_hash }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_position_type_id value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_carrier_type_id value = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_carrier_type_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_appointment_receipt_id value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_appointment_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_cycle value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_state value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case_id value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case_hash value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_closure_receipt_id value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_closure_receipt_hash value = var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_result_grade value = var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_result_grade }

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_displaced_cost_amount value = var:zg361_we_offer_gold_paid }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_displaced_cost_receipt value = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id multiply = 1000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_offer_gold_paid multiply = 10 } add = 5 } }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_displaced_cost_hash value = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash multiply = 100000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_offer_gold_paid multiply = 100 } add = 2775 } }

# D+1 native revoke dispatch.  The complete exit intent and authorization are
# now committed, so the native callback can authenticate this exact request
# without reading values written earlier in its own effect chain.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_dispatch_native_exit_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pending = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_state = 6
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_request_authorized
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_request_authorized = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_slot_was_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_owner = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_cycle = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_cycle
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_case
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_former_slot_id
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_former_slot_hash
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_slot_carrier_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_carrier_type_id
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_carrier_type_id = 3612771
            has_court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
            is_court_position_employer = {
                court_position = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_career_slot_court_position
                who = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner
            }
            zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
                OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner
                SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject
                CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
                CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
                STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state
                ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_active
                EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner
                EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
                EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_cycle
                EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_case
                EXPECTED_STATE = 6
            }
            var:zg361_we_m274_hired = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_hire_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_case
            var:zg361_we_m274_native_appointment_confirmed = 1
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_type_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_position_type_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_appointment_receipt_id
            var:zg361_we_m274_position_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_appointment_receipt_hash
            var:zg361_we_m269_outcome_settled = 1
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active = 1
            var:zg361_we_formal_hc_active_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_case
            var:zg361_ch_hc_occupied = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_hc_occupied_before
            var:zg361_ch_hc_frozen = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_hc_frozen_before
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_pending = 1
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_owner = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_subject = this
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_cycle = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_cycle
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_state = 4
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case_id
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_case_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_case_hash
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_id = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_closure_receipt_id
            var:zg361_b2_workforce_pip_closure_receipt_hash = var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_pip_closure_receipt_hash
            var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_code = 2
            var:zg361_b2_pip_outcome_result_grade = 1
        }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_request_dispatched value = 1 }
        var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_exit_owner = {
            revoke_court_position = {
                recipient = root

            }
        }
        trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceexitfact.9003 days = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        zg361_workforce_exit_fact_clear_exit_pending_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code value = 27709 }
    }
}

# Publish the five legacy #277 fields through the existing strict adapter.
# IDs/hashes are supplied internally from the sealed receipt, never by this
# public package's caller.  Verification is delayed to another event so the
# adapter ACK is not read back in the same effect chain.
zg361_workforce_exit_fact_publish_to_workforce_m277_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_red_code
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_active
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_active = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_sealed = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_published = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_consumed = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_subject = this
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_state = 6
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_reason_kind = 1
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_misconduct_present = 0
            var:zg361_workforce_exit_fact_receipt_native_callback_seen = 1
